info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Virtual Account Management API
info.description: The Virtual Account Management API enables users to update the settings and details of virtual accounts within the deposit lending system. This functionality allows financial institutions to manage their virtual accounts effectively, adapting to client needs and regulatory requirements. Typical consumers include banking application developers and financial service providers looking to enhance their lending products. This API streamlines the process of maintaining and modifying account information, ensuring an efficient user experience.

patch.summary: Update the details of a virtual account.
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to modify the attributes of a specific virtual account identified by its account number. Use this operation to update account settings or other relevant information as necessary.
